title: 4 Bedroom 4 Bath~11 Beds~Rooftop! Huge Space
description:
Welcome to our epic 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom pad! Picture-perfect rooftop views, 15 comfy beds, and a fully loaded kitchen await your crew. Just a quick Uber hop to downtown hotspots and a stone's throw from Top Golf. Game room on with an 85-inch TV!

The space
LISTING MUST KNOWS 
 2 miles to Downtown Nashville
 Towels and Linens provided
 Iron & Board/ Steamer
 Washer/Dryer
 Keurig Coffee machine
 Fully stocked modern kitchen
 State of the Art Appliances
 4 Bedrooms 4 Bathrooms plus flex room
 11 Beds & 3  Air mattress 
 Large Open Concept Living Area
 Large Rooftop deck with amazing views
 Indoor Dining
 Outdoor Lounge space
 Cable access on TV's
 SMART 4k TVs with streaming capability in every bedroom and living room + cable
 Smart Lock Keyless Entry
  1 Garage Parking available and free street parking on 27th ave
 Dedicated workspaces throughout the house 
 Blazing fast internet
 240v 40 AMP Fast Car Charging included for Electric Vehicles with free overnight charging
 Garage Game Room with Cornhole, darts, connect 4,
 
Traveling doesn't mean having to eat out for every meal. We supply all of the kitchen necessities so you are able to cook or reheat leftovers easily! We have everything from pots and pans, and a Keurig coffee maker, to wine glasses and corkscrews! 

Use bunk beds at your own risk 

Guest access
Entire home
There is also access to the complex fire pit and grill area. 

Sleeping arrangements
Bedroom 1 - 2 single bunk beds
Bedroom 2 - 1 queen bed
Bedroom 3 - 2 single beds
Bedroom 4 - 1 king bed
Flex room - 1 single bunk bed plus trundle
Common area - no beds

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional.

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

If you have any questions, just message us anytime! Happy to help!

Guest access
Entire home
